newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Polar to issue 5.4 mln new shares for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Polish Polar to issue 5.4 mln new shares for IPO.

text.p: Polish white appliances maker Polar SA set for bourse entry in mid-year, will issue up to 5.4 million new shares as its initial pubic offering before bourse entry, the company's president said on Monday.

Zbigniew Szczypinski told a news conference that after the new issue and bourse flotation the state treasury, which has 100 percent or 8.9 million shares in Polar, would also sell part of its shares at a special bourse session.
He did not say what stake in Polar the treasury wanted to sell. He said the new shares would be offered in three tranches for institutional and individual investors and for employees. @
He said 900,000 shares would be offered for empoloyees but did not give size of the two other tranches.
Polar expects to net at six million zlotys in 1997, up from last year's 1.6 million, on sales of 560 and 497 million zlotys respectively.
